description: This PHP script handles duplicate record processing in vtiger CRM, including merging records, transferring related records, and rendering merge UI.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering UI components.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from one entity to another during merge.

methods.name: DeleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes an entity record by ID.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab context for the UI.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific actions.

methods.name: getRecordValues
methods.description: Fetches record values for given IDs.
